docs.title: BONELAB EXT SDK Documentation
docs.text: For BONELAB SDK modders using notnotnotswipez's Extended SDK. Written by AMOAM (and others but mainly AMOAM did the whole thing, thanks AMOAM)

docs.title: Introduction
docs.text:
This documentation will attempt to list everything relating to all scripts included in notnotnotswipez's Extended SDK.

Each script documentation will have this structure:

  • What the script does and how it's used
  • Script requirements
  • An image example of the script
  • All the usable properties and what they affect
  • Other useful advice regarding the script

docs.title: Cylinder Grip
docs.text:
A type of grip that lets you hold items like handles, rods, beams and sticks.

This grip lets you slide your hand across it while not holding the GRIP button.

While holding the GRIP button, your hand stays fixed at its current position along the cylinder grip.

docs.title: Requirements
docs.text: A Cylinder Grip must have a Capsule Collider on the same GameObject with Is Trigger typically set to True, and Direction typically set to Z-Axis, although these values are not strictly required. The GameObject must be set to the Interactable layer.

docs.title: Properties
docs.text: Property Name Property Type Property Usage Is Throwable bool Typically always true. DOES THIS DO ANYTHING WHEN FALSE? Ignore Grip Target On Attach bool If true, the Target value won't be used when determining the position of your hand for the grip. THEN WHAT'S USED INSTEAD? Additional Grip Colliders Collider[] While this grip is held, the Colliders in this list won't collide with your body. NEEDS VERIFICATION Handle Amplify Curve AnimationCurve UNKNOWN Hand Pose HandPose When this grip is held, your hand will match the pose assigned. Primary Movement Axis Vector3 When this object is gripped, this axis should be pointing in the same direction as your thumb in a "thumbs up" position. Typically set to (0, 0, 1). Secondary Movement Axis Vector3 When this object is gripped, this axis should be pointing down your forearm. Typically set to (0, 1, 0). Grip Options InteractionOptions See InteractionOptions.

docs.title: Stab Slash
docs.text: Gives a Marrow Entity (a spawnable) the ability to stab and damage enemies and certain spawnables. Also can be used to inflict blunt damage.

docs.title: Requirements
docs.text: A Stab Slash must be on the same GameObject as a Marrow Entity.
